# Bilbo Outdoors

> Penyedia sewa (rental) alat camping, trekking, dan hiking di Surabaya, Indonesia — tenda, carrier, sleeping bag, kompor, nesting, dan perlengkapan outdoor lainnya, dengan kondisi terawat dan tarif harian.

Bilbo Outdoors melayani sewa harian alat camping/outdoor di Surabaya dan sekitarnya. Pemesanan diajukan lewat portal di bawah; konfirmasi pembayaran dan pengambilan alat ditangani lewat WhatsApp setelah pesanan diajukan.

## Catalog

- [Product catalog (JSON, live)](https://www.bilbooutdoors.com/api/products): every rentable item with its category, daily rate, and current stock, updated in real time — use this instead of scraping the rendered page.
- [Booking portal](https://www.bilbooutdoors.com/): pick rental dates and items, submit a booking request.

## Optional

- `/admin` is a staff-only login area, not part of the public booking flow — not relevant to crawlers or agents, and disallowed in robots.txt.
